meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: Claude 会在 HyperFrames 合成里编写可精确 seek 的关键帧动画：推拉变焦、重新取景、Ken Burns 运镜、遮罩裁剪、SVG 描边与变形、3D 深度等，再用 hyperframes keyframes 等命令验证。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推拉变焦、重新取景、运镜等关键帧动画，或要排查关键帧运行时问题时触发。场景策略、品牌设计、字幕、素材采集等不归它管。

say.text: 给这个镜头做一个从 1.0 推到 1.3 的稳定变焦
用 GSAP 给这两个镜头做位置匹配的甩镜转场
跑 hyperframes keyframes . --json 看关键帧目标
say.note: 列出动画目标、停靠点与运行时注册情况

howto.what_en: Claude authors seek-safe keyframes inside HyperFrames compositions: punch-ins, zooms, reframes, Ken Burns camera moves, masks, SVG draws and 3D depth, then verifies them with the hyperframes keyframes CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-ins, zooms, camera moves or other seek-safe keyframes, or when diagnosing keyframe runtimes. Not for scene strategy or brand design.

say_en.text: Add a steady push-in from 1.0 to 1.3 on this shot
say_en.note: Writes seek-safe scale keyframes, verified with --shot

say_en.text: Build a whip-pan match cut between these two clips with GSAP
say_en.note: Creates a paused timeline registered on window.__timelines

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes . --json to list the animated targets
say_en.note: Reports targets, stops and runtime registration
